description: One Forever item: agreed name, observed loot-window drop frequency, agreed map pins, and player-reported armor, block, damage per second, stats and resistances. Each item number needs one value with 3 agreeing installs in the newest build with 3 reporting installs, and no competing value with 3; contested values are withheld. Each number states its agreeing installs, build and last seen, with the corpus date and method. Missing numbers are [?] with a reason. No baseline rows or player names. Reads Everloot's current authorized public corpus when connected. Missing or unavailable data is reported explicitly.

itemId.description: Item id from a drop row.

name: item_page

connected.description: False when no corpus was read; the page is then absent, which is not a measured zero.

dataAsOf.description: The corpus snapshot time, or null when unrecorded.

drops.description: Windows with this item; 0 is a measured zero.

kills.description: Observed loot windows, not a census of kills.

source.description: The source in words, with its agreed name when it has one.

name.description: Null until 3 installs report the same name.

pendingLoot.description: Loot windows reported but not yet in the rates. Absent when there are none.

windows.description: Reported loot windows not yet in the rates.

pins.description: Agreed positions of the NPCs it drops from; a pin needs 3 installs on the same map.

reported.description: Player-reported item numbers, decided per line in the newest build with 3 reporting installs. Missing lines are unknown, never zero.

contested.description: No unique value has 3 agreeing installs; no value is disclosed.

lastSeen.description: Latest agreeing report not after the corpus date; null means [?].

reason.description: Why nothing was read, when connected is false.

url.description: The everloot.app page that shows this answer, absolute. Absent when there is no such page or it would be empty.

title: Item page for a drop
